Download FIFA 2022 Mod FIFA 14 Apk Obb Data files, comes with up to date players transfers, new season kits, improved graphics, new balls, commentary name fix and more.

FIFA 2022 Mod 14 Apk works offline as Android soccer game where you will be able to manage your own football club from season to season and also play tournament matches.

Manager mode in FIFA 2022 Mod FIFA 14 Apk offline also allows you to choose your favourite football club and manage, for example you can manage football club like Chelsea, Arsenal, Real Madrid etc.

All this clubs above have there latest season kits updated in the new FIFA 2022 Apk offline for Android, it is all about simulating the activities of real world of football in your Android device where you become a real coach by playing home and away matches.

Players now have real faces in the latest FIFA 2022 Mod Apk, you will be able to see this realistic faces when players move around the pitch.

Background music usually players within the FIFA Soccer game 2022 edition, just like in the previous edition of the game, this background music inspires you for a better game play and entertainment.

Control buttons that enables you to pass, shoot, make long pass, control player movement e.g navigation buttons, assist buttons are very responsive in this latest edition of FIFA 2022 Apk Obb file.

In this mod of FIFA 22 apk game for mobile phones, upon installation, you will see unlimited amount of virtual money which can be used to manage your football club.

The database file for FIFA 2022 Mod 14 Apk has been optimised, it doesn’t force close or hang after a particular match, making it possible for you to play many manager mode seasons.

How To Install FIFA 2022 Mod FIFA 14 Apk Obb Data

After you have downloaded the FIFA 2022 Mod 14 Apk Obb Data files above, carefully follow the steps below to extract the Obb Data files for the game and also install the Apk app.

Watch Installation Video 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CfnajzVxvuE

Section A: Steps To Extract FIFA 2022 Data File

  1. Using Installed Zarchiver App, locate FIFA 22 Data Rar file.
  2. Click on it and options menu will come up.
  3. From options menu click “Extract Here” to extract data file in current folder.
  4. Extracted file will be “com.ea.game.fifa14_row” locate it in the current folder you extract it.
  5. Click and hold on “com.ea.game.fifa14_row”, options menu will come up and then click “Copy”.
  6. And goto device memory.
  7. Click Android folder.
    1. Click data folder (data folder can be found in Android folder in step 7).
  8. Click paste icon like in the image below.

Note: when next there’s update, remember to delete “com.ea.game.fifa14_row” folder in Android/Data folder and follow the steps above to extract new data file again.

Section B: Steps To Extract FIFA 22 Obb File 

  1. Using Installed Zarchiver App, locate FIFA 22 Obb rar file in downloads folder.
  2. Click on it and options menu will come up, then click “Extract”.
  3. Immediately goto “Device Memory”.
  4. Click Android folder.
  5. Click Obb Folder.
  6. Click Extract Icon which looks like Arrow pointing downwards.
  7. FIFA 2022 Obb rar file will be decompressed successfully (Extracted) upon reaching 100%.
  8. Finally Install FIFA 22 Mod Apk.
